about: P5.7: own IELTS-style General Training Writing Task 1 letter tasks written by GoNative in the session (not official IELTS material). Checked by code (letter-spec) and reviewed by a second vendor before entering the library.

spec.situation: You ordered a washing machine from an online shop. It arrived two weeks late, and when it was installed you found that it was damaged.
spec.recipient: the customer services manager of the shop
points: give details of your order
describe the problems with the delivery and the machine
say what you would like the shop to do

spec.situation: You would like to take an evening course at a local college, but the college website does not give all the information you need.
points: say which course you are interested in and why
explain what experience you already have in this subject
ask for the information you need

spec.situation: For the last month, building work near your home has continued late into the evening and sometimes starts very early in the morning.
points: describe the building work and when it happens
explain how it is affecting you and other residents
suggest what the council should do

spec.situation: You have seen an advertisement for a part-time job as a weekend guide at a museum in your town.
points: say where you saw the advertisement and why you are interested
describe your relevant experience and skills
explain when you would be available to work

spec.situation: You recently travelled by train and left a bag on the train when you got off.
spec.recipient: the lost property office of the train company
points: give details of your journey
describe the bag and what was in it
say how the company can contact you and return it

spec.situation: You often visit a park near your home, but you feel that it has not been well looked after recently.
spec.recipient: the parks department of your city
points: explain how often you use the park and what you use it for
describe what is wrong with the park now
suggest how it could be improved

spec.situation: You stayed at a hotel for three nights last month. After you returned home, you noticed that the hotel had charged your card twice.
points: give details of your stay
explain the problem with the payment
say what you want the hotel to do

spec.situation: You have read in a local newspaper that the town plans to close one of its public libraries to save money.
points: explain why this library is important to you
describe who else would be affected by the closure
suggest another way for the town to save money

spec.situation: You need to take a week off work next month for an important family event.
points: explain why you need the time off
say which days you would like to take
suggest how your work could be done while you are away

spec.situation: You rent a flat, and the heating has stopped working. You have already tried to contact your landlord by phone without success.
points: describe the problem with the heating
explain how it is affecting you
say when it would be convenient for someone to repair it

spec.situation: Your neighbour's dog barks for most of the day while your neighbour is at work. You do not know this neighbour well.
points: describe the problem
explain why it is difficult for you
suggest a solution

spec.situation: You are taking an evening course, and you have missed the last two classes because you were ill.
points: explain why you missed the classes
ask what you need to do to catch up
say when you expect to return

spec.situation: You are applying for a new job, and the employer has asked for a reference from someone who knows your work.
points: remind them who you are and when you worked together
describe the job you are applying for
explain why you are asking them for a reference

spec.situation: You are a member of a local sports club, and the training sessions have recently been moved to a time that does not suit many members.
points: say how long you have been a member
explain the problem with the new training times
suggest a better arrangement

spec.situation: You have an idea that you think would make your workplace a better place to work.
points: describe the current situation at work
explain your idea
say how staff and the company would benefit

spec.situation: You recently stayed in a small guest house run by its owner. When you got home, you realised you had left something behind.
spec.recipient: the owner of the guest house
points: thank them for your stay
describe what you left behind and where
ask them to send it to you and offer to pay the cost

spec.situation: You have recently moved to a new home in another town.
points: describe your new home and the area
invite your friend to visit
suggest some things you could do together

spec.situation: A friend invited you to their birthday party, but you were not able to go.
points: apologise and explain why you could not come
ask about the party
suggest a time to meet and celebrate together

spec.situation: A friend looked after your home and your pet while you were away on holiday.
points: thank your friend for their help
tell them about your holiday
offer to do something for them in return

spec.situation: A friend is going to study in the city where you live and has asked you for advice.
points: give advice about where to live
describe what you like about the city
offer to help when they arrive

spec.situation: You started a new job a month ago, and you have not had a chance to tell an old friend about it.
points: describe your new job
say what you like and dislike about it
explain how your daily life has changed

spec.situation: A friend lent you their camera for a trip, and it was damaged while you were using it.
points: explain what happened to the camera
apologise for the damage
say what you will do to put things right

spec.situation: You are organising a meeting of people who were in your class at school ten years ago.
points: give details of the event
explain why you need help with the organisation
suggest what your friend could do

spec.situation: You recently went to the wedding of a friend you both know, but your friend could not come.
points: describe the wedding
say what you enjoyed most about the day
give some news about other people who were there
